gloss: to fail to hear; to miss hearing; to let slip

forms.negative: {聞|き}き{逃|のが}しませんでした

forms.negative: {聞|き}き{逃|のが}していなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.affirmative: {聞|き}き{逃|のが}していました

definitions.gloss: to fail to hear; to miss hearing
definitions.explanation: to not catch what was said, either by accident or inattention

definitions.gloss: to let slip; to not pursue what was heard
definitions.explanation: to deliberately overlook something problematic that was said

examples.japanese: {名前|なまえ}を{聞|き}き{逃|のが}した。
{大事|だいじ}な{発表|はっぴょう}を{聞|き}き{逃|のが}さないでください。
examples.english: Please don't miss the important announcement.

examples.japanese: その{発言|はつげん}は{聞|き}き{逃|のが}せない。
{騒|さわ}がしくてアナウンスを{聞|き}き{逃|のが}した。
examples.english: It was noisy, so I missed the announcement.

examples.japanese: {失礼|しつれい}な{言葉|ことば}を{聞|き}き{逃|のが}すわけにはいかない。
examples.english: I can't let such rude words slide.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}の{中|なか}で{駅名|えきめい}を{聞|き}き{逃|のが}した。
examples.english: I missed hearing the station name on the train.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}の{言葉|ことば}は{聞|き}き{逃|のが}せないな。{撤回|てっかい}してくれ。
examples.english: I can't let what you just said slide. Take it back.

notes:
{聞|き}き{逃|のが}す means either accidentally missing what was said or deliberately overlooking something.

VERB TYPE:
- Godan verb (す-verb)
- Transitive

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {聞|き}く (to hear) + {逃|のが}す (to let escape)
- Part of the ～{逃|のが}す compound pattern

SENSE 1 (ACCIDENTAL):
- Missing information unintentionally
- Common in noisy environments
- Used with announcements, names, explanations

SENSE 2 (DELIBERATE):
- Choosing not to respond to something problematic
- {聞|き}き{逃|のが}せない (cannot be overlooked) is very common
- Often in contexts of insults or inappropriate remarks

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名前|なまえ}を{聞|き}き{逃|のが}す (miss hearing a name)
- アナウンスを{聞|き}き{逃|のが}す (miss an announcement)
- {大事|だいじ}な{話|はなし}を{聞|き}き{逃|のが}す (miss important information)
- {聞|き}き{逃|のが}せない (cannot be ignored)

CONTRAST WITH {聞|き}き{流|なが}す:
- {聞|き}き{逃|のが}す: Failed to hear or can't ignore
- {聞|き}き{流|なが}す: Deliberately ignored, let pass

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- {見逃|みのが}す (to overlook, miss seeing)
- {取|と}り{逃|のが}す (to let slip, miss catching)
- {聞|き}き{流|なが}す (to let pass, ignore)

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday conversation.
